### Is God Unrighteous?
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-unrighteous
Passage: Romans 3:5-7
Points:
- God's glory and righteousness remain absolute regardless of how human beings respond to Him.
- The Lord proves His faithfulness both in forgiving believers and in justly punishing impenitent sinners.
- Objecting that God is unfair to judge sin because our unrighteousness highlights His goodness is flawed human logic.
- As the sovereign Judge of the universe, God is inherently righteous and cannot act unjustly.
- Doubting divine justice reflects creaturely arrogance, calling believers to repent and trust God's revealed character.
